label: GPT-6 Luna
output:
Rohan, fair question da. You and Divya trusted me with real money, so you deserve a straight answer—not a LinkedIn captain speech.

We let 6 of our 14 people go last Friday. It was the worst day I’ve had as a founder, and I’m not going to dress it up. We gave everyone two months’ pay, and we’ve already helped four people get interviews. Still awful. Worse than failing maths in second sem, and that’s saying something.

The bridge round from the Hyderabad fund fell through on 28 October. The term sheet was basically ready; then the partner said “we love the energy” and went quiet for 11 days. Apparently energy is not legal tender. After the cuts, we have about five months of runway.

The business is mixed. We have around 41,000 monthly users, and the plumbers and electricians side is growing. AC servicing is losing money, so we’re planning to shut that down and focus on housing-society tie-ups. Three societies in HSR have signed pilots. I think we have a real shot there, but it’s a shot—not a sure thing.

So, on your question: your 3 lakh is still invested on the same terms as everyone else in the 2025 friends round. The money is at risk. I can’t honestly tell you it’s safe, and I don’t know what the eventual outcome will be. It’s not gone, but I also can’t promise you’ll get it back. I know that’s not a comfortable answer. It’s the honest one.

I should have reached out to you directly rather than letting you hear about the layoffs through a post. Sorry about that. Can we get on a call with you and Divya properly this week? I’ll walk you both through the numbers and answer whatever you want to ask. You shouldn’t have to guess what’s happening with your money over dinner.

And Sneha, I’m breathing. Just at 11pm over office Maggi, where the security uncle now asks whether I want masala or plain. Amma has also started asking if TCS is hiring, so the family morale dashboard is… mixed. I’m okay, though—no need to practise the sad face on my account.

I’m still coming Saturday. Pranav’s buying, apparently, so at least one cash-flow forecast this week looks promising.
